message: Approved SETUPRACE-1 plan requires recoverable notify_claim_at state, stale reclaim, confirmJobSetupNotified, reloaded-session routing, and docs updates, but the recorded SETUPRACE-1-1 decomposition/brief requires fingerprint-only CAS plus clear and excludes those required docs/surfaces from write scope; implementation contract is inconsistent.

notes: Fixed: the decomposition objective now specifies the recoverable design (notify_claim_at, CAS with stale reclaim, confirmJobSetupNotified, clearJobSetupNotified, reloaded-session routing), and write_scope now includes docs/decisions/0117 + docs/specs/setuprace-1.md. Implement the recoverable-claim plan.

message: Atomic claim-before-delivery sets notified_fingerprint, but setup-pause prompt revalidation treats that pending claim as already delivered and canonical parsing drops notify_claim_at; correctness requires adding apps/core/src/domain/job-types.ts, apps/core/src/adapters/storage/postgres/services/canonical-job-target-state.ts, and apps/core/src/application/jobs/setup-pause-permission-prompt.ts to scope (plus affected tests), or revising the plan to store a separate claim fingerprint.

notes: Approved scope expansion: added apps/core/src/domain/job-types.ts, apps/core/src/adapters/storage/postgres/services/canonical-job-target-state.ts, and apps/core/src/application/jobs/setup-pause-permission-prompt.ts to write_scope. Plumb notify_claim_at through the canonical parse/serialize so it is not dropped, and make the prompt revalidation treat a PENDING claim (notify_claim_at != null) as not-yet-delivered. Keep the single notified_fingerprint marker + notify_claim_at pending/confirmed distinction (do not add a separate claim fingerprint).

message: SETUPRACE-1-1 requires changing apps/core/src/application/jobs/job-permission-recovery.ts: its fallback sends before markJobSetupNotified and discards the returned token, violating claim-before-send and leaving recovery claims unconfirmed, but the file is outside the write scope.

notes: Out of SETUPRACE-1 scope; recorded as follow-up. job-permission-recovery.ts (notifyStillBlockedSetupPrompt) is the post-grant recheck path, not the concurrent-creation/run race SETUPRACE-1 targets, and it is not concurrent with itself. It still works with the new markJobSetupNotified signature (a non-null token is truthy where the boolean was checked; typecheck + its updated tests pass). Adopting claim->confirm/clear there for full uniformity is a separate hardening follow-up.
